# AURORA (04 · aurora)

An Arctic retreat beneath a live aurora — fbm noise curtains, stars, and a KP-index gauge.

- **Technique:** FBM SHADER
- **Tags:** nature, calm, night, travel, hospitality, atmospheric, shader, nordic
- **Best for:** hotels & retreats; travel; outdoor brands; wellness
- **Fonts:** Cormorant, Outfit
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;1,300;1,400&family=Outfit:wght@200;300;400;500&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #060b18 · #78e6c8 · #9d8bf0
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/aurora/` (Template.astro, content.ts, gauge.ts, meta.ts, sky.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* aurora — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --night: #060b18;
  --night2: #0a1226;
  --night3: #101b36;
  --mint: #78e6c8;
  --mint-hi: #a4ecd4;
  --violet: #9d8bf0;
  --icy: #d7e8f5;
  --icy-dim: #8fa5bd;
  --icy-faint: #54677f;
  --scroll-thumb: #1c2a4a;

  /* mountain ridges and KP gauge */
  --ridge-far: #04070f;
  --ridge-near: #02040a;
  --gauge-track: #182645;
  --gauge-tick-off: #2a3a5c;

  /* aurora shader colors, quantised from the original GLSL vec3 constants */
  --gl-sky-low: #020409;
  --gl-sky-high: #060b1a;
  --gl-star: #cce6ff;
  --gl-curtain: #2ef2a8;
  --gl-curtain-hi: #8059f2;
  --gl-fringe: #e64d8c;
  --gl-horizon: #0d1f1f;

  --serif: "Cormorant", serif;
  --sans: "Outfit", sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
}
```

## Signature effects
- `gauge.ts`
  - `initGauge(svg: SVGSVGElement)` — Half-circle KP gauge drawn into `svg`: ticks 0–9 (lit up to `kp`), a track, and a mint→violet value arc. Reads `data-kp` and `data-label`.
- `sky.ts`
  - `initSky(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement)` — Full-bleed aurora: layered fbm noise curtains over a starfield, drawn in a fragment shader. Shader colors come from the `--gl-*` tokens. Falls back to a CSS gradient without WebGL.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<i>/<br>/<a>/<span> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Line icon drawn on an experience card. */
export type ExperienceIcon = 'sauna' | 'plunge' | 'lodge';

export interface Experience {
  /** Italic index in the card's top-right corner, e.g. "No. 1". */
  no: string;
  icon: ExperienceIcon;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  /** Pill under the text, e.g. "+85°C". */
  temp: string;
}

export interface Stat {
  value: string;
  label: string;
}

export interface Room {
  /** Large italic index shown left of the room (hidden below 900px). */
  no: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  price: string;
  href: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Brand wordmark in the nav and footer; the <b> is tinted mint. */
  wordmarkHtml: string;
  /** Section anchors available: #experience, #forecast, #rooms. Nav is hidden below 900px. */
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    sub: string;
    cta: Link;
    /** Coordinates line, bottom-left of the hero. */
    coord: string;
    scrollLabel: string;
  };
  experience: { kicker: string; headingHtml: string; items: Experience[] };
  forecast: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    /** Geomagnetic index (0–9): drives the gauge and the first stat. */
    kp: number;
    /** Label under the gauge number (upper case). */
    gaugeLabel: string;
    /** Label of the KP stat in the side list. */
    kpLabel: string;
    noteHtml: string;
    /** Further stats listed after the KP stat. */
    stats: Stat[];
  };
  rooms: { kicker: string; headingHtml: string; items: Room[] };
  footer: { addressHtml: string; creditHtml: string };
  /** Showcase-only chrome; rendered only when the Template receives `showcase`. */
  showcase?: { chipLabel: string; chipHref: string; footerHtml: string };
}
```

## Use it
- Full site: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs template aurora --out <dir>`
- Style kit for an existing project: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs style aurora --out <dir>`
